change.notes: One 024 forward-only ACL extension grants the Gateway role column-scoped SELECT on exactly six pairing challenge fields and eight channel fields used by the native Local Node pair, heartbeat, control, and receipt paths. It preserves existing INSERT/UPDATE table rights, grants no table-level SELECT, and adds no SELECT on other columns. Root must review and measure this exact 023-to-024 extension in an isolated database before activation.
